faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: Before booking your session, clear up the most common questions about how the VIP Advisory works.

items.question: What if I don't qualify for any visa?
items.answer: We'll tell you honestly during the session and guide you on the most sensible next steps, even if today's answer is “not yet”.

items.question: Is the session a video call?
items.answer: Yes, the session is online, 1-on-1 with Ivon, on whichever platform works best for you.

items.question: Will I receive anything after the session?
items.answer: Yes. You'll get your immigration path documented, plus WhatsApp follow-up for specific questions.

items.question: What is the EB2 NIW?
items.answer: It's a permanent residence visa for professionals with exceptional or advanced ability who benefit the national interest of the U.S. It does not require an employer sponsor.

items.question: When can I schedule the session?
items.answer: Right after payment you'll receive a link to pick an available time on Ivon's calendar.
